notes: ① 面板重排：删掉标题下那一整段导语，改成「标题行 + 一行元信息 + 五格指标条」。标题行 = 配置同步 + 本机徽标 + 云端徽标 + 「重新检测」按钮；元信息行只留 app 版本 / Electron 版本、分支 @ 短 HEAD；指标条五格是 本机/契约、bundle、依赖、备份快照、上次同步，哪一格有问题就转橙或转红，「待办」只在真有事时才出现。② 文案整体精简：卡片里的长解释改成一行 11px 灰字脚注，脚本用法、令牌、备份目录这些不再堆成正文；同步目标、自动化、插件更新、还原备份、同步内容各卡的提示都压到一句话。③ 修掉三处排版问题：插件更新卡的状态正文原来和按钮挤在同一行，英文会被压成两段（“no newer version upstr / eam”），现在正文独占一行；键名列窄会导致英文 “Branch / HEAD” 换行，加宽到 92px；脚注不再用 break-all，英文不会在词中间断开。④ 还原备份卡：去掉「快照数量」那一行（标题旁已经写着几份），快照列表从一条一个小框改成细分隔线，生成成功后的三条提示压成一行路径 + 一行命令行 + 一句脚注。⑤ 同步内容卡：每组从「标题一行 + 说明一行」并成一行（标题 12.5px，说明 11px 灰字跟在后面），十组一屏看完，展开明细、必需组锁定、只读优先这些行为不变。⑥ 云端仓库地址未配置从 error 改成 warn：原来左侧红徽标「有问题」和右侧云端「一致」会同时出现，自相矛盾。⑦ README 中英的 panel 截图换成 0.3.14 这一版，README.en 标题里的 “What the panel shows” 一节按新布局重写。
notesEn: (1) The panel is re-laid out: the paragraph of intro text under the title is gone, replaced by a title row, a one-line meta row and a five-cell metric strip. Title row = Config Sync + local badge + cloud badge + "Re-check"; meta row keeps only app version / Electron version and branch @ short HEAD; the strip shows App/contract, bundle, dependencies, snapshots and last sync, turning orange or red where something is off, and the to-do card appears only when there is something to fix. (2) Copy is trimmed across the board: long explanations inside cards became a single 11px grey footnote, so script usage, tokens and backup folders no longer fill the body — every card keeps one line of hint. (3) Three layout bugs fixed: the plugin-update status text used to share a row with the buttons and got squeezed into two columns in English ("no newer version upstr / eam") — it now owns a full row; the key column was too narrow for "Branch / HEAD" and wrapped, so it is 92px; footnotes no longer use break-all, so English words are not split mid-word. (4) Restore-backup card: the "snapshot count" row is gone (the title already says how many), snapshots are separated by hairlines instead of individual boxes, and the three post-generation hints collapsed into one path line, one command line and one footnote. (5) Sync-content card: each group is now one row (title at 12.5px with the description in 11px grey right after it), so all ten groups fit one screen; expanding details, required-group locking and read-only-first all behave exactly as before. (6) An unset cloud remote is now a warning instead of an error: it used to show a red "problem" badge on the left and "in sync" on the right at the same time. (7) The panel screenshots in README (zh and en) are replaced with this 0.3.14 version, and the "What the panel shows" section in README.en is rewritten for the new layout.
